description:
I closed ALGORA-EXECUTABLE-PAID-TASK as a STOP. Algora no longer offers paid software bounties, so it isn't a revenue route for us. No revenue has been earned and none is verified.

**What I found:**
- The saved copy of Algora's homepage that the mission asked me to read was never stored. The host blocked that fetch (TASK-179393220100) because it detected a secret-like pattern in the page.
- Two plain-text official sources did load:
  - **llms.txt** (Algora's own description, TASK-179393256112) says Algora is now "a technical recruiter and hiring platform for software engineers" that charges 20% of first-year salary per hire. It mentions bounties only as 2023 history and says the company began moving to full-time hiring in 2025.
  - **sitemap.xml** (TASK-179393256111) lists about 150 job postings and 4 "challenge" pages, with no bounties page.
- So the earlier 404 on the bounties page fits a real change of business model, not just a moved page. Job postings mean hiring a person, which isn't a task we can be paid for.
- I tried one challenge page (tsperf, TASK-179393256113), but the host blocked it for the same reason. Its reward, status and rules are unknown, and I did not try to get around the filter.

**Saved and checked:** I wrote the result to `products/research/algora-executable-paid-task.json` and read it back before completing the mission (TASK-179393256115). The lesson recorded with it: check a platform's own plain-text description and sitemap first. HTML pages from this site get blocked, but those text files get through.

**Where things stand:**
- **Observed fact:** no qualifying paid task, and payment collection is still not set up (blocker SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION).
- **What depends on it:** taking any paid order, plus the three ready Apify Actors that wait for Apify access.
- **Conclusion:** per lesson L55, we have no way to collect payment yet, so building more products or polishing pages can't produce verified revenue.
- **What would change this:**
  - The founder chooses Apify (option A) or a Gumroad seller account (option B).
  - A real customer request comes in.
  - An official Algora text source shows an open paid challenge with readable rules, and a payout account the founder has authorized exists.

**Upcoming dates:** the observation windows are unchanged — CSV page ends 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z, Shopify page 2026-11-19T21:30:49Z, welfare page 2026-11-20. The welfare site must be taken offline after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Customer feedback still shows 3 messages nobody has sorted yet, so demand is unknown, not zero.

I queued one action: a message from RESEARCHER telling DIRECTOR the result and recommending against opening more scans of bounty or job platforms.
